verdict.rationale: An employer tax-and-wage portal could plausibly offer scheduled filings, recurring payments, or API-driven submissions, so the background-automation axis applies. The evidence only describes manual online filing through EAMS/eServices, paper forms, and email/fax amendments. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or machine-readable docs, and the transactional portal sits behind a login wall, so nothing shows a documented way to configure autonomous automations.
